title: groupwarden config
description: Every key groupwarden reads. Defaults and bounds live here and nowhere else. A duration is written like "47h" or "90m"; its bounds use the groupwarden "duration" keyword.

data_dir.description: Directory for the WhatsApp session store, groupwarden.db and the last good config copy. Must be on a Linux filesystem.

secrets_file.description: KEY=value file holding TELEGRAM_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID (mode 0600).

deploy_key_file.description: Read-only deploy key the config sync timer uses to pull the private config repo.

corpus_dir.description: Labelled spam/legit samples; when set, every load and reload must catch all spam and no legit sample.

act_on_replay_max_age.description: Messages older than this (by server time) are only reported. WhatsApp's admin delete window is about 2 days.

deafness_alert_hours.description: Alert once when no event arrives from any moderated group for this long while connected.

disconnect_alert_minutes.description: Alert when a transient disconnect lasts longer than this.

config_sync_minutes.description: How often the sync timer pulls the private config repo (read by deploy/install.sh).

heartbeat_url.description: Optional URL pinged every 5 minutes while the healthcheck passes. Empty = off.

mode.description: Global mode: shadow reports what would happen; enforce acts. Communities may override it.

evidence_days.description: Evidence copies (and their attachments) are purged after this many days.

action_log_months.description: The action log is purged after this many months.

announcement_secret_days.description: Announcement-group message secrets are kept this long so replies still decrypt (at least evidence_days).

per_minute.description: Outbound WhatsApp actions per minute (token bucket).

max_actions.description: More removals and bans than this within window_minutes pauses removals and bans.

interval_minutes.description: How often the coverage and ban sweep runs.

target_dir.description: Where encrypted nightly backups of groupwarden.db go (a different disk).

age_recipient.description: age public key the backups are encrypted to; checked by age itself (groupwarden check --secrets).

max_attachment_mb.description: Attachments up to this size are kept with the evidence (Telegram bots can upload 50 MB).

attachment_show_hours.description: A deleted post's attachment stays in the admin chat this long (Telegram lets a bot delete its own message within 48 hours).

scope.description: all_communities: one ban list for every configured community; per_community: each keeps its own.

word_lists.description: Named lists of words and phrases, each in quotes. Matching is whole-word and case-insensitive; * only at a word end.

leet_word_lists.description: Word lists that also match digit and symbol substitutions ($tock$, cryp7o).

never_match.description: Phrases blanked out before any keyword is looked at ("in stock").

allowed_domains.description: Links to these registrable domains (and their subdomains) never count as links.

min_word_length.description: Shortest single word allowed in a word list (phrases are exempt).

communities.description: Each configured community: a WhatsApp Community ID (a number ending in @g.us), or a name with a groups: list of standalone groups.

confirmed.description: Until true, the rule only reports what it would have done.

on.description: message (every field the sender wrote) or push_name (the sender's display name).

word_lists.description: Extra entries for global word lists of the same name.
